description: Value in EUR of a list of holdings on 1 January 00:00 Dutch time of the given year, using each holding's platform price. Returns value per line and the total. Lines without a price are marked missing and not counted. Also returns a link to the calculator. Nothing is stored.

holdings.description: Holdings, one line per coin and platform. The same coin may appear on several platforms.

amount.description: Number of coins held on the reference date, e.g. 0.5.

coin.description: Coin ticker, name or slug, case-insensitive, e.g. "BTC", "bitcoin", "eth", "ripple".

platform.description: Exchange platform where the coins were held.

year.description: Reference year: prices on 1 January of this year (for the tax return over that year). Available: 2014–2026.

name: value_portfolio
title: Value holdings on the reference date
